text:
alyssa: opening warroom — multiple customers reporting 502/504s and timeouts hitting hosted inference in us-east-1, started ~11:18 UTC. customers: acme-invoice, beta-ux. tagging oncall @mike and infra lead @jordan

mike: on it, pulling gateway logs now. can someone post a quick repro curl if customer has one?

jordan: seeing spike in conn-stalls from edge->runtime. 95th latency to model pool jumped at 11:17:55. possible connection reuse/keepalive issue.

sre-bot: alert: hosted-inference-us-east-1 gateway 5xx rate > 8% over 5m. recent deploy: router-proxy v2.14.3 at 11:05 UTC.

tara: customers report increased client retries causing amplification. support said they saw streaming responses stall before 5xx.

mike: can we quickly rollback router-proxy to v2.14.2? is that safe without breaking other regions?

jordan: rollback ready, but want to confirm repro first. trying to reproduce locally with a small load against canary.

sam: pasted a minimal repro from acme: ```bash
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"model":"gpt-x","input":"long prompt..."}' https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate
``` they get timeout after 10s then 504.

natalie: adding customer-facing note to support ticket: we have an active investigation and a targeted mitigation. avoid asking customers to rotate keys.

jordan: reproduced in canary: connection pool exhaustion on proxy -> keepalive pings not being recycled fast enough, long tail KV cache miss traffic making backend busy. patch prepared to reduce keepalive timeout and increase max idle conns.

mike: patch looks small, but prefer rollback then patch. initiating rollback of router-proxy to v2.14.2 now.

sre-bot: deploybot: rollback started for router-proxy in us-east-1. user: mike.

paul: noticed auth proxy returned transient 502s for streaming websockets too. could be same conn pool pressure.

jordan: rollback completed at 11:30 UTC. metrics: 5xx rate falling from 9.2% -> 1.1% over 4m. latency p95 improving.

tara: support-bot, please push interim comms to affected customers and mark incident in support tracker.

support-bot: support queue updated: incident reference #INC-175555. Customers notified with ETA for full postmortem.

alyssa: good mitigation. next: root cause deeper analysis and action items. jordan to lead RCA on connection reuse and patch the keepalive defaults. sam to audit KV cache hot keys from ingress. natalie to follow up customer comms + SLA impact calc. mike to schedule canary for patched proxy.

mike: adding canary windows for patched router-proxy v2.14.4 in eu-west first, then us-east. target deploy in 2 hours once tests pass.

jordan: timeline: today - produce RCA notes, include stack traces and traces from jaeger. action: backport patch to 2.14.x, add integration test for conn reuse under KV miss bursts.

sam: action: write a short script to generate KV-miss heavy load to validate autoscaler behavior and batching. will PR by EOD.

natalie: action: prepare templated customer follow-up with incident summary, root cause, mitigation, ETA for permanent fix, and credit offer if SLO breached.

alyssa: owners assigned, please add to postmortem doc and link eval tests that showed regression. capture whether quantized model variants amplified latency.

jordan: quick note — we saw that long-prefix requests (>=8k tokens) increased BK runtime GPU long-tail, exacerbating pool pressure. will include in RCA.

mike: any blockers for full postmortem?

paul: need logs from edge nlb for a 10m window; ops-logs retention cut overlap made some entries sparse. request retention bump for incident investigations.

alyssa: k, ops to follow up on retention. final ask: everyone add one mitigation and one long-term action to the postmortem checklist. I'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to review before publishing. thanks team :thumbsup:
